citation: Postcard History, 'The Story of Edson Keith', April 2023. Read 5 November 2026.
author: Postcard History
locator: The account of Edson Keith's illness and death, from the Chicago Daily Tribune and Chicago Chronicle of September 1896.
rights_note: Cited in words only; nothing copied beyond short quoted fragments.
access_notes: Read 2026-11-05 (T-3378/T-3379) through a fetch that returned the page's sentences in short quoted fragments and paraphrase; this record is cited only for what those fragments say.
note: Fragments read: Edson Keith, merchant of Edson Keith & Company, suffered for at least a decade from insomnia and dyspepsia; on Monday 21 September 1896 he left his house in the early morning, walked to the lake at the foot of 16th Street and drowned himself; the papers said he 'committed suicide Monday morning by drowning himself in Lake Michigan'. The page does not give his Prairie Avenue number.
